subject: Got error when use ggmap on Shiny

messages.author: 29d4de1be4045917
messages.subject: Got error when use ggmap on Shiny
parts:
Hi,
I am new to Shiny, and I am struggled to show the ggmap on my shiny web app. If anyone could give me some hints, i would really appreciate.
Now my map code is as below:

output$map <-  renderPlot({
  df <- geocodeData()
  gc <- geocode('Pittsburgh, PA')
  center <- as.numeric(gc)
  al2 <- get_googlemap(center = center, makers = df, zoom = 16, maptype = 'roadmap', size = c(7500, 7500))
  p <- ggmap(al2, extent = 'panel') + geom_point(data = df, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude), colour = "red", size = 4)
  print(p)
})

the geocodeData() is a data frame I got from a reactive function. So i will have latitude and longitude columns in that data frame.(The latitude and longitude are from calling google geocode API)

The error message I got is :
Error in 1:nrow(df) : argument of length 0

The geocodeData() should be fine since I use the renderTable to show it on my web app. 


Thanks a lot!

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Got error when use ggmap on Shiny
parts:
1. Generally, get this error due to df is NULL. you can add "print(df)" below to "df <- geocodeData()" to see. 

2. You should also post how you define geocodeDate(). 

3. Instead of define a reactive function, try to use reactiveValues.
